fuente.titulo: Report from the Cathedral of Notre Dame in Paris with Pope Leo

titular: Pope Leo XIV enters Notre Dame after 2019 fire
bajada: First pontiff to step inside the cathedral since the blaze that shook Paris
caption: Pope Leo XIV became the first Pope to enter Notre Dame Cathedral since the devastating 2019 fire, visiting during his Apostolic Journey to France. Source: Vatican News, Sept. 25, 2026.

ilustracion.descripcion: Illuminated facade of Notre Dame Cathedral at dusk, restored stone towers glowing, a robed pope figure entering the doorway in the upper right third, left and center open and clear
